copy.description: A charming hand-illustrated wildflower bouquet featuring daisies, cornflowers, coneflowers, lavender sprigs, buttercups, and delicate white blossoms, tied together with a rustic twine bow. This artwork brings a fresh, garden-inspired look perfect for custom prints, cards, or decorative items.
copy.altText: Illustrated wildflower bouquet with daisies, cornflowers, coneflowers, and lavender tied with a twine bow
copy.caption: A rustic wildflower bouquet illustration bursting with color
